Chapter 1256: Chapter 14: Exploring the Second Source World (Requesting Monthly Votes at the Beginning of the Month)

"This is a good thing."

The Da Fu Ancestor thought to himself.

Although in this timeline, the means displayed by the Galaxy Venerate are terrifying, morphing into a ’Black Dragon,’ with strength nearing the Thirteenth Rank.

But the Galaxy Venerate is not an enemy of the Da Fu Ancestor.

On the contrary, their relationship is quite good, at least through Da Fu Ancestor’s efforts to make friends, the Galaxy Venerate has a favorable attitude towards him.

Moreover, in this timeline, the Black Dragon the Galaxy Venerate transformed into seems to be the result of comprehending the ’Abyss Dragon’s Heart.’

And the ’Abyss Dragon’s Heart’ was gifted by the Da Fu Ancestor, adding to the bond between them invisibly.

"The gap between life and life, how can it be so vast..."

The Thunder Origin Ancestor exclaimed, originally thinking that Thirteenth Rank Time Life was already the pinnacle of all beings.

But compared to the Galaxy Venerate, even Time Life pales in comparison.

The other ancestors nodded in agreement, the more they observed Lin Yuan’s timeline, the more a sense of despair welled up.

Lin Yuan’s growth speed is so fast, even making Time Life seem bewildered.

If it weren’t for this newly emerged treasured land’s contest, making the Ancestor of Fierce Sun and the other five ancestors aware of the Galaxy Venerate’s existence.

By the time the ancestors noticed Lin Yuan, he might have already crossed into the Thirteenth Rank.

"The stronger the Galaxy Venerate becomes, the more beneficial it is for us."

The Primordial Ancestor of the Barbarian Wilderness remarked, according to the future glimpsed in the timeline, being an enemy of the Galaxy Venerate would surely be disastrous.

But if one could befriend the Galaxy Venerate, as long as the relationship isn’t too bad, there would still be no negative impact.

"It’s estimated that three hundred million years into the future, the Galaxy Venerate will touch the level of the Time Lords."

The Da Ling Ancestor stated, in the future they currently observe, three hundred million years ahead is considered forbidden, that period is locked down, anyone who dares to watch will suffer backlash.

And only the Time Lords can achieve this.

Originally, the ancestors speculated if Lin Yuan three hundred million years later would have a major cause with a Time Lord, leading to his timeline being sealed.

Now it seems, the greater possibility is that Lin Yuan himself becomes a Time Lord?

"Time Lord?"

The other ancestors exchanged glances, their hearts filled with unspeakable awe.

Thirteenth Rank Time Life observes time lines of future past, but theoretically, future timelines are endless, regardless of how many are seen, it can never offer insight into all timelines, ultimately only nearing infinitely.

Therefore, to break through to the Fourteenth Rank and become a Perfect Time Being, one must first consolidate their own timeline, completely dominate one timeline, becoming the lord of that timeline, or the Time Lord.

The power of the Time Lords is unimaginably strong, reaching the level of Time Lords means not being confined to one dimensional space, but wandering between different external dimensional spaces.

Know that even for Thirteenth Rank Time Life, other dimensional spaces are unfamiliar, a slight mistake may lead to danger.

...

The ancestors observe Lin Yuan’s future timeline, which Lin Yuan himself is aware of.

When five ancestors visited him, they eventually asked if they could continue observing his timeline.

In response, Lin Yuan agreed, as he also wants to know how certain his future is.

Moreover, the ancestors promised if they found a particularly unique future timeline, they would promptly inform him.

...

Hei Yu Nest.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, refining several precious Hei Yu stones.

"My current strength of mind willpower should have surpassed three hundred million points, right?"

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, the first-class treasured land Hei Yu Nest of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country produces precious Hei Yu stones, greatly effective in refining and enhancing willpower.

Of course, Lin Yuan’s willpower reaching three hundred million points is not solely reliant on the precious Hei Yu stones.

In fact, the role of Hei Yu in this is not substantial.

The enhancement of willpower mainly has two aspects.

One aspect is internal.

One aspect is external.

Internally, it’s the elevation of life’s own strength realm, naturally nurturing stronger willpower.

During this time, Lin Yuan’s strength has undergone several qualitative changes, such as evolving the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Dao, practicing ’Infinite Void’ to the Fourth Layer, stepping into the Chaos Realm, etc.

The surge in life tier and strength realm has naturally brought about a significant uplift in willpower.

Especially the evolution of the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Dao, this power led Lin Yuan to an all-around transformation, with willpower included.

As for external reasons?

The ’Hei Yu’ produced by Hei Yu Nest is also considered an external factor.

But the six Ancient Countries not only have Hei Yu capable of refining and enhancing willpower.

Other precious and rare items can achieve similar effects too.

For example, the ’Dragon Abyss Blood’ produced in Dragon Abyss Valley.

Refining ’Dragon Abyss Blood’ not only enhances the mind’s will but also elevates the physical body and soul in all aspects.

Through the contest over the treasure land, Lin Yuan traded with various ancient nations and acquired a full hundred catties of Dragon Abyss Blood.

Even if half of the hundred catties of Dragon Abyss Blood are reserved for studying and comprehending, the remaining half is enough to significantly elevate Lin Yuan’s mental will.

Moreover, besides Hei Yu and Dragon Abyss Blood, there are other rare treasures to enhance the mind’s will. Lin Yuan has used his transactions with the ancient nations to gain numerous of these, and all were utilized in recent times.

The combination of external and internal factors led to Lin Yuan’s mental will, which was less than a hundred million points before mastering the Hei Yu Nest, now directly crossing the threshold of three hundred million points.

It must be understood... the enhancement of mental will becomes increasingly difficult at later stages, yet Lin Yuan experienced a four to five-fold increase in a short period. Even if the primary reason lies in the breakthrough of his realm power, one can imagine just how many benefits he absorbed.

"Three hundred million points of mental will probably means I’ve reached the limit of the twelfth tier. Continuing further, even with improvement, it won’t be much."

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself, feeling that his mental will was approaching some limit. To experience another exponential surge, he might have to wait until he crosses into the thirteenth tier where the essence of life undergoes a metamorphosis.

"However, three hundred million points of mental will is enough for me to allocate some effort to try exploring the next source world."

Lin Yuan always kept in mind the coordinates of those thirty-three source worlds deep within the Myriad Realms Gate.

After crossing into the twelfth tier, Lin Yuan’s method of traversal appeared different; traversals beyond the twelfth tier no longer affected his true corporeal form, contrastingly increasing the burden on his mental will greatly.

This meant Lin Yuan’s mental will at the time could only bear the exploration of one source world. To explore a second source world, he would have to abandon the first one.

But now, with the substantial enhancement of his mental will, Lin Yuan had gained the confidence to maintain the Chaos Void and the true form of the first source world while attempting to explore a second source world.

"The second source world..."

Lin Yuan’s expression was slightly solemn.

The reason he hadn’t explored the second source world wasn’t only due to the pressure of his mental will but also because of the warning and reminder from the Myriad Realms Gate—

The second source world contains unknown dangers, and reckless exploration could lead to irreversible impacts!

Lin Yuan trusted the judgment of the Myriad Realms Gate, which is why he hadn’t taken any action until now.

But now?

Lin Yuan’s substantial gains were not limited to his mental will but also included his own strength.

To be precise, the enhancement of his mental will originated from the improvement of his strength.

And danger depends on strength. When strength is low, the danger is naturally high; when strength is high, the danger becomes low.

"I should go take another look now."

Lin Yuan’s consciousness immediately delved into the depths of his mind, looking toward the towering and majestic Myriad Realms Gate.

"Myriad Realms Gate..."

Every time Lin Yuan observed the Myriad Realms Gate, he felt something different, and this time was no exception. The Myriad Realms Gate felt as if it transcended the Origin Source of source worlds.

"More real than before..."

Lin Yuan closely observed the Myriad Realms Gate in his mind’s depths—a projection of the true Myriad Realms Gate. Even though Lin Yuan had been acknowledged by the Myriad Realms Gate as its master, he couldn’t withstand the arrival of the actual Myriad Realms Gate.

Much like a small kettle, it cannot contain the vast oceans and seas.

"If I crossed into the thirteenth tier, even if still unable to bear the true arrival of the Myriad Realms Gate, I could at least touch a fragment of its consciousness to explore more of its functions..."

Lin Yuan contemplated, having now confirmed that the existence of the Myriad Realms Gate far exceeded the thirteenth tier. At least, compared to the six ancestors of the six great ancient nations, the Myriad Realms Gate felt far superior.

It must be noted that this is only a projection of the actual Myriad Realms Gate.

"Let’s begin."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and attempted to probe the depths of the Myriad Realms Gate, targeting the space-time coordinates of the second source world.

Whoosh!

Lin Yuan’s consciousness followed the path of the Myriad Realms Gate, crossing unknown spatial dimensions, faintly arriving at a gray, hazy realm.

"No warning or reminder from the Myriad Realms Gate this time?"

Lin Yuan’s mind steadied. According to his understanding of the Myriad Realms Gate, the absence of a specialized warning or reminder indicated that this source world posed no real threat to him.

The so-called real threat refers to impacts linked to the true corporeal form in other dimensions.

For Lin Yuan, as long as it doesn’t involve the true corporeal form in other dimensions, even if the true corporeal form in this dimension perishes, it wouldn’t be a major issue—at worst, starting over again.

"This world..."

From the perspective of the Myriad Realms Gate, Lin Yuan began briefly observing bits and pieces of the second source world.

"Something’s off?"

Lin Yuan’s brow slightly furrowed, feeling that the second source world was permeated with a certain deadness, yet simultaneously possessed a strange vitality.

"Interesting."

After just a brief observation, Lin Yuan’s consciousness rapidly shattered.

"Since there’s no real danger, let’s descend directly."

In his mind’s depths, Lin Yuan gazed at the majestic Myriad Realms Gate, and after only a moment’s contemplation, he immediately began traversing.

The target was none other than the second source world.

Buzz!!

The Myriad Realms Gate faintly trembled, and a portion of Lin Yuan’s mental consciousness was instantly absorbed within it.
